page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Top: a faint line of capitals. Below it the large title ORATIONUM, then smaller lines in italic and capitals, then a woodcut device in the middle, then the printer's imprint at the foot.
page.notes: Woodcut device (a tree or emblem with a banner) in the centre of the page, no text. A manuscript shelf mark in ink ("1-6-A-38") at the top right is not transcribed. Lines of the title are faint and show-through from the reverse, which is mirrored, so several readings are doubtful. The imprint at the foot is largely illegible; a date with reversed-C numerals seems to be present but cannot be read reliably.
